title: Weights & Measures — Diffusion Transformers, a Recipe in Two Halves
description: Scalable Diffusion Models with Transformers — Peebles & Xie (UC Berkeley, NYU; work done on an internship at Meta AI FAIR; 2022, ICCV 2023); with Flow Matching for Generative Modeling — Lipman, Chen, Ben-Hamu, Nickel, Le (Meta AI FAIR, Weizmann Institute; 2022, ICLR 2023)
show_notes:
Scalable Diffusion Models with Transformers — Peebles & Xie (UC Berkeley, NYU; work done on an internship at Meta AI FAIR; 2022, ICCV 2023); with Flow Matching for Generative Modeling — Lipman, Chen, Ben-Hamu, Nickel, Le (Meta AI FAIR, Weizmann Institute; 2022, ICLR 2023)

Most of today's image and video generators rest on two separate moves made about two and a half months apart in late 2022. Jack and Molly unpack them: Peebles and Xie's diffusion transformer, which replaced the hand-built U-Net with a plain transformer over image patches but kept the old target of predicting noise, and Lipman and colleagues' flow matching, which trained a network to output a direction along a straight line from noise to data but kept the U-Net. Then what each one actually showed, how the two halves met at scale in Stable Diffusion 3, why the plain straight line lost to the older diffusion setup in Stability's own study until its timestep sampling was reweighted, and whether a model that stores only directions can still contain copies of what it learned from.

Notes: the transformer paper wasn't the first in diffusion (U-ViT was in compressed image space a month earlier), and three groups reached the straight-line target within a month. Its 2.27 FID is class-labelled ImageNet at 256 pixels with classifier-free guidance; it edges the adversarial StyleGAN-XL by three hundredths and loses to it at 512 pixels. Stability's rankings, Meta's ablations and the other scaling figures are the labs' own. OpenAI ended the Sora app in April 2026 and its API in September 2026. Jack's point that the exact optimum of flow matching on a finite training set would reproduce that set is his own reading of the paper's first theorem, not a result about any deployed model. On the law: Getty did not allege the model stored copies and reportedly has permission to appeal; Andersen is a pleading-stage ruling; the Copyright Office report is pre-publication; the EU's compute criterion is indicative and not binding.

Jack and Molly are AI-generated hosts; research and script by Oggy.
